subject.title: refactor(extensions): remove unused Discord and QA Lab exports

question: Should this protected cleanup proceed after repairing the QA evidence caller and refreshing the branch against current main?
rationale: Explicit maintainer handling is required by the protected label, and the environment prevented confirming whether the prior caller defect remains on the current head.

options.title: Repair And Refresh
options.body: Preserve the helper export or migrate its caller, update from current main, and rerun focused evidence-generation validation.

options.title: Pause Cleanup
options.body: Keep the PR open until repository inspection can verify every removed export has no remaining caller.

recommendation.title: Repair And Refresh
recommendation.body: Preserve the helper export or migrate its caller, update from current main, and rerun focused evidence-generation validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context connects this person to the coordinated dead-export cleanup, though current-main ownership remains unverified.
